actions.action: Monitor rainfall forecasts and weather updates
actions.reason: Early awareness enables timely preparation if conditions worsen

actions.action: Review local drainage and waterlogging reports
actions.reason: Baseline situational awareness of infrastructure condition

actions.action: Ensure emergency contact lists are up to date
actions.reason: Preparedness measure to reduce response delay if escalation occurs

actions.action: Check battery levels on communication equipment
actions.reason: Communication readiness is foundational for any emergency response

actions.action: Inspect storm drain conditions in the zone
actions.reason: Moderate rainfall can overwhelm partially blocked drains, causing localized flooding

actions.action: Check emergency response equipment availability
actions.reason: Equipment readiness reduces deployment time if the situation escalates

actions.action: Alert local emergency coordination personnel
actions.reason: Early notification enables faster mobilization if intervention is needed

actions.action: Review zone-specific vulnerability data
actions.reason: Understanding local risk factors helps prioritize response if conditions deteriorate

actions.action: Identify potential temporary shelter locations
actions.reason: Pre-identification avoids delay if temporary relocation becomes necessary

actions.action: Review vulnerable infrastructure in the affected zone
actions.reason: High rainfall significantly increases risk of structural waterlogging and access disruption

actions.action: Place response teams on standby readiness
actions.reason: Reducing mobilization time is critical when conditions may escalate rapidly

actions.action: Actively monitor citizen reports from the zone
actions.reason: Citizen reports are often the first indicator of on-ground emergencies

actions.action: Verify safe access and egress routes
actions.reason: Flooded roads can cut off evacuation and response access unexpectedly

actions.action: Coordinate with medical response units
actions.reason: Medical emergencies increase during high-rainfall events due to waterborne hazards and injuries

actions.action: Pre-position rescue boats if available
actions.reason: Water rescue equipment must be staged before roads become impassable

actions.action: Escalate continuous monitoring of all zone indicators
actions.reason: Critical conditions require real-time situational awareness to prevent loss of life

actions.action: Prioritize verified emergency reports for immediate review
actions.reason: Report volume increases during critical events; triage prevents resource misallocation

actions.action: Deploy available response resources to staging areas
actions.reason: Pre-deployment reduces response time for imminent rescue operations

actions.action: Notify the responsible human operator / incident commander
actions.reason: Critical situations require command-level oversight and decision authority

actions.action: Activate backup communication channels
actions.reason: Primary communication infrastructure may fail during severe flooding

actions.action: Coordinate with district emergency operations center
actions.reason: Cross-agency coordination is essential when local capacity may be exceeded

actions.action: Document all actions and decisions for post-event review
actions.reason: Accountability and learning require a clear record of emergency response decisions
